output.summary: A widespread genus of shrubs and dwarf shrubs found worldwide except Australia and Antarctica, mostly in cooler parts of the Northern Hemisphere. Its species typically favour acidic soils, and the fruits of many species are eaten by people, including blueberries, cranberries and bilberries.
output.edibilityNote: The fruits of many species are eaten; commercially important examples include blueberries, cranberries, bilberries, lingonberries and huckleberries.
